titel: Which printed part goes where? Number every cut 🔥 | Blender
printzin: Every printer is different: print the fit test first.

scenes.tekst: Twelve printed parts, and no idea where?
scenes.label: QUICK QUESTION

scenes.tekst: Click Cuts engraves a number into every cut face.
scenes.label: THE FIX

scenes.tekst: Each face shows its own part number and the part it joins.
scenes.label: NEIGHBORS

scenes.tekst: It is sunk into the cut, so the outside of your model stays clean.
scenes.label: CLEAN

scenes.tekst: And it sits where there is room, not on top of a pin hole.
scenes.label: SMART SPOT

scenes.tekst: Smaller faces get smaller numbers, so the text still fits on the face.
scenes.label: SMALL FACES

scenes.tekst: Open More settings, step three, to set the depth: 0.6 millimetres by default.
scenes.label: SETTING

scenes.tekst: Parts are numbered from bottom to top, so you build up in order.
scenes.label: ORDER

scenes.tekst: Export parts, and the files are named piece zero one, piece zero two, in that order.
scenes.label: EXPORT

scenes.tekst: Every printer is different. Print the fit test first, then the parts.
scenes.label: PRINT FIRST

scenes.tekst: Click Cuts for Blender. Link in the description.
scenes.label: CLICK CUTS
